findings.summary: The initial compiler did not bind the repository, package ID, or package version to the accepted release subject, so a structurally valid snapshot for another subject could compile.
evidence: Verification: PR #255 initial review https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination/pull/255#issuecomment-5516948866 records changes-required at exact head a60c1e30ba284f88b73849176d8cc97ab8d60df1; `git diff a60c1e30ba284f88b73849176d8cc97ab8d60df1..6da56287bbbe2bbb7b26ffa3924a8a9196dc5e54 -- src/FS.GG.Coordination.Qualification.Contracts/GitHubReleaseHardeningQualification.fs eng/validate-github-release-hardening.fsx tests/FS.GG.Coordination.UnitTests/GitHubReleaseHardeningTests.fs` shows that the initial compiler lacked repositoryBinding and packageIdentityBinding and that its generated controls did not attack alternate repository, package ID, or version values.
resolution_evidence: Verification: exact repair 6da56287bbbe2bbb7b26ffa3924a8a9196dc5e54 adds repository and package identity bindings plus alternate-subject negative controls; PR #255 confirmation https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination/pull/255#issuecomment-5516993061 records a pass at that exact head after repair round 1.

findings.summary: A later exact-head audit found that unknown corpus properties were accepted and five purportedly independent controls delegated their oracle to generated mutations, leaving fail-closed shape and independent-proof requirements materially unproven.
evidence: Verification: PR #255 changes-required confirmation https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination/pull/255#issuecomment-5517141834 binds exact head 01b196d4d2f41be1058155197c6d9b400365809c and states that unknown corpus properties were ignored, five safety controls delegated their independent oracle to generated mutations, and evidence was stale; critic succession grant https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination/pull/255#issuecomment-5517139697 records that this fresh audit superseded the earlier pass.
resolution_evidence: Verification: `git diff 01b196d4d2f41be1058155197c6d9b400365809c..5e876400371947033fdf99ab0e6d2a93782bbda0` adds exact-property validation at the corpus, feed, recovery, expectations, and independent-case boundaries, five retained shape attacks, and separately named independent fixtures for all 21 controls; final PR #255 confirmation https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination/pull/255#issuecomment-5517224429 passes exact repaired head 5e876400371947033fdf99ab0e6d2a93782bbda0 with the unknownCredentialSecret reproduction exiting 1, stable Q3 seal, unit 182/182, architecture 446/446, and SDD 20/20 verification obligations.
